description_for_human: AIGoGo prospecting: OpCos, qualified prospects, evidence, outreach and outcomes.
description_for_model: Use for anything about Hijojo, AIGoGo OpCos, prospecting profiles, prospects, why a company was chosen, scores, evidence, outreach emails and their QA, replies, handoffs to Mark, and outcome measures. Always fetch data with these functions; never invent prospects, scores or evidence. Hijojo cannot send email from here.

functions.name: listOpcos
functions.description: List OpCos with status and prospect counts per stage.

functions.name: getOpco
functions.description: Get an OpCo's prospecting profile; items are FACT, INFERENCE or UNKNOWN.

functions.name: listProspects
functions.description: List an OpCo's prospects, optionally filtered by stage.

functions.name: getProspect
functions.description: Explain one prospect: who, why them, why now, score, evidence with links, communications with QA verdicts, replies, handoffs, activity.

functions.name: getOutcomes
functions.description: Get outcome measures and whether sending is live, simulated or halted.

functions.name: addOpco
functions.description: Add an OpCo for Hijojo to research. Needs a website, or notes plus an intro link.

confirmation.title: Add OpCo to Hijojo
confirmation.body: Hijojo will research **{{ function.parameters.name }}** and build its prospecting profile. Nothing is sent until prospects qualify and pass independent QA.

functions.name: recordProspectFeedback
functions.description: Record whether a prospect should have been contacted (false positive).

confirmation.title: Record prospect feedback
confirmation.body: Record this judgement? It is used to tighten qualification.

functions.name: recordHandoffVerdict
functions.description: Record whether a handed-off opportunity is worth pursuing (ACCEPTED or DECLINED).

functions.name: haltSending
functions.description: Emergency stop: halt all outbound email. Only an administrator can resume, in the Hijojo app.

confirmation.title: Halt all Hijojo sending
confirmation.body: This stops every outbound email immediately. Only an administrator can resume it in the Hijojo app.
